page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a woodcut ornament and large initial at top; a ruled line below the theses, then a small-type block of approval notes and signatures below. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf in the right half is ignored. No margin notes.

main_text.head: PARERGA.
I.
main_text.p: VTRVM Episcopi ac reliqui Sacerdotes, verum ac legitimum haheant dominium fructuum ; seu redituum Ecclesiasticorum? nos in vtramque partem disputabimus.
main_text.head: II.

p.i: VTRVM contractus iure ciuili nullus, sit etiam in conscientia nullus, ita vt obligationem non pariat? Vtrumque problematicè defendemus.

main_text.head: III.

p.i: AN iudici liceat, contra veritatem quam certò nouit iudicare quando legitimè probatur contrarium? Nos in vtramque partem disputabimus.

main_text.head: IIII.

p.i: PRÆSCRIPTIO sic transfert dominium, vt etiam super veniente possit impletam præscriptionem scientia, quod res illius qui præscripsit ante præscriptionem non fuerit: eam nihilominus tuta conscientia possit retinere.

main_text.p: Has de locatione Theses, nihil aduersus catholicam fidem continentes, dignas censeoque typis descriptæ, ad publicam disputationem proponantur.
MICHAEL EISELIN de Societate IESV Theologiæ Collegij hoc tempore Decanus.
Censeo & ipsæ vt Theses hæ doctissimæ imprimantur & ad disputandum publicè proponantur.
ANDREAS FACHINEVS iuris Cæsarei Professor ordinarius & collegij iuridici hoc tempore Decanus.

page.notes: The ornamental initial V is a woodcut, read as V. The approval block is set in smaller type and is given as foot paragraphs in the printed order; the signature lines are transcribed as set. Some words in the italic theses are doubtful but read clearly enough at this scan resolution. Printed forms such as "Episcopi" and "Theses" are kept as printed.
